To draw the projections of the points:

i) **Point A ($70\text{ mm}$ above HP, on VP):**
- Front View ($a'$): $70\text{ mm}$ above $XY$ line.
- Top View ($a$): Lies directly on the $XY$ line.

ii) **Point B ($50\text{ mm}$ below HP, $30\text{ mm}$ above VP):**
- Front View ($b'$): $50\text{ mm}$ below $XY$ line.
- Top View ($b$): $30\text{ mm}$ below $XY$ line.

iii) **Point C ($15\text{ mm}$ above HP, $40\text{ mm}$ behind VP):**
- Front View ($c'$): $15\text{ mm}$ above $XY$ line.
- Top View ($c$): $40\text{ mm}$ above $XY$ line.
proTip: Always project top views and front views along the same vertical projector line.
